name: claude-companion
description: Hand code review and general tasks to Claude Code from Codex. Runs the Claude CLI headlessly and returns structured findings or a report.

interface.shortDescription: Review code or delegate a task to Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Get a second opinion from Claude Code without leaving Codex. $claude-review runs a read-only review of the working tree or branch and returns findings ranked by severity with file and line. $claude-task hands any request to Claude, read-only by default or with write access on request, and returns its report.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $claude-review to get a second opinion on my current changes.
